show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/EbQ4LA
show.description: A humble salesman, Tanay, secretly the heir to a massive business empire, hides his identity to find true love with Dia. Misjudged as poor, he faces insults from her greedy family while proving his worth through hard work. Dia betrays him for wealth, unaware of his real status. After rising as a powerful entrepreneur, Tanay exposes the truth, leading to regret, revenge, and justice.
